node: Data-center power delivery, grid interconnection, transformers, switchgear, and thermal infrastructure
summary: Layer 1B expansion found a compact direct-exposure universe around the AI data-center power stack. The strongest underfollowed candidates are not GPU or hyperscaler names, but firms tied to medium-voltage switchgear, dry-type transformers, liquid-cooling/power distribution components, and regional utility service territories where binding data-center load contracts are turning AI demand into rate-base or backlog signals. This is a research universe only, not a recommendation list. POWL and HMDPF are the cleanest equipment bottleneck candidates; NVT is a larger, more visible power-and-cooling component platform; EVRG is a regulated utility/load-growth candidate that needs tariff, capex, and customer-credit verification.
